name: Zocos de Safi
hero_subtitle: Everyday markets, produce and small craft in the old town.

overview.title: Markets of daily Safi
overview.p1: Safi’s souks are practical markets more than tourist bazaars: produce, household goods, spices and some craft.
overview.p2: Morning is liveliest. You walk, watch, maybe buy fruit or a small item, and continue toward the medina or the port.
overview.p3: They pair naturally with a medina loop and a stop at the Sea Castle later in the day.

food.title: Snacks around the souks
food.p1: You can nibble as you walk; sit-down meals are better at the port or calm cafés.
food.li3: Proper fish lunch at the port.
food.li5: Wash or peel fruit when in doubt.
food.p2: The souks are for atmosphere and light purchases more than a long meal.

q2.question: Are prices fixed?
q2.answer: Some stalls are flexible; polite bargaining is fine for non-food items.

q3.question: Is it touristy?
q3.answer: Less than in imperial cities — mainly local trade.

q4.question: Can I take photos?
q4.answer: Ask before close-ups of people or private stalls.

q5.question: How long do I need?
q5.answer: 45 to 90 minutes as part of a medina walk.
